cues.text: You run into the entrance hall of Tartarus with Akihiko, Junpei and Fuuka and stop short. You, Akihiko and Junpei raise your fists, ready to fight.

A motorcycle lies on its side, smoking, at the foot of the great staircase. Before the stairs stand two giant Shadows: one with a huge round body marked by a cross, on thin legs, its long arms hanging; the other round, with a fan of feathers behind its head, a cape and a raised scepter. Yukari sits on the floor near the stairs, propped on her hands, and Mitsuru lies beside her.
A girl in a school uniform walks slowly into the hall, toward the Shadows.
Fuuka runs across the hall to Natsuki.
Natsuki sinks to her knees in front of Fuuka. Behind them, the two Shadows turn toward the girls.
Fuuka turns around to face the Shadows, with Natsuki kneeling behind her.
